dont_use_when.text: Do not use Top Nav Link outside Top Nav.

best_practice.text: Use Active for the section the person is in, on one link only.
Keep link labels to two or three words, such as Track a case.

gaps.detail: State=Default: the Top Nav documentation page (184:1039), which holds the Top Nav Link set does not say what this value is for (checked usage region 184:1275).
Top Nav Link composes no other component and no story pairs it with a sibling component outside Top Nav.

Top Nav Link has no documentation page of its own; its entries are the rules on the Top Nav documentation page (184:1039), which holds the Top Nav Link set that name Top Nav Link or its variants. Rules written for the Top Nav as a whole are not copied.
